name: btcpoker
description: Playable NLHE poker with auditable dealing and (stubbed) Bitcoin payments

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/rng packages/poker-core packages/payments packages/server packages/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/rng packages/poker-core packages/payments packages/server packages/client --force && echo typecheck ok
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
